newsitem.title: INDIA: FII holding in Mastek 26 pct-India RBI.
newsitem.headline: FII holding in Mastek 26 pct-India RBI.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday barred foreign institutional investors (FIIs) from purchasing equity in Indian software firm Mastek Ltd. without prior clearance from the central bank.
RBI said it was taking this step because FII holdings in Mastek had reached 26 percent.

"The Reserve Bank of India has notified that the aggregate net purchases of equity shares of Mastek Ltd by FIIs in the primary/secondary market together with purchases made by NRIs and OCBs under the portfolio investment scheme have reached 26 percent of paid-up equity capital," an RBI spokeswoman said.
The bank also included purchases made by Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) and Overseas Corporate Bodies (OCBs) in fixing the limit.
The statement added, "No futher purchases iof equity shares in this company should be made without prior clearance of the Reserve Bank."
